purpose: Independent first-party registry/map discovery and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Tumakuru City Corporation has a public municipal PID/assessment property-search procedure, and Karnataka's official Revenue Commissionerate portal documents Bhoomi/SSLR Revenue Maps. No anonymous parcel geometry response with a safe native identity was verified, so no GeoJSON sample was retained and runtime remains held.
registryAssessment: Local municipal property-search custody is evidenced by the Tumakuru City Corporation page. State cadastral/revenue-map service custody is evidenced by the Karnataka Revenue Commissionerate portal. Neither source was verified as an open city-bound parcel vector service.

officialPrimarySources.observation: HTTP 200 public ASP.NET page; instructions describe lookup by PID or by ward and old/new assessment number, with Kannada text. Form action is PropertySearch.aspx. No safe geometry endpoint was exposed and no property lookup was submitted.

officialPrimarySources.operator: Revenue Department, Government of Karnataka / Bhoomi Monitoring Cell
officialPrimarySources.observation: HTTP 200 official portal; lists Survey (SSLR) Services and Revenue Maps and identifies the state-government operator.

officialPrimarySources.operator: Karnataka Legislature-hosted Tumakuru Urban Development Authority report
officialPrimarySources.observation: Annual report describes GIS-based master-plan/base-map work for the Tumakuru local planning area; it is planning evidence, not a public parcel geometry service.

searchQueries.query: Tumakuru Karnataka official cadastral parcel map land records GIS Bhoomi survey map
searchQueries.result: Official state land-records service directory and municipal property-search page found; no verified public parcel vector endpoint.

attempts.attempt: Official state portal and service-route inspection
attempts.result: Portal home accessible; service3 Revenue Maps route timed out on direct anonymous retrieval. No TLS exception, login, CAPTCHA bypass or token use.
HTTP 200 form retrieved; form documents PID/ward/assessment lookup. No form submission or unsafe field request.

requests.outcome: HTTP 200; HTML saved to ignored scratch cache only

geometryDecision.details: No full parcel polygon and no verified stable cadastral native identity were obtained. No exact-point hit or miss was used to infer coverage.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Tumakuru municipal property-search procedure plus Karnataka state Bhoomi/SSLR Revenue Maps service directory.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Public service documentation and one accessible municipal form only; parcel geometry, schema, CRS and citywide extent remain unverified.

remainingUncertainty: The official state service may expose Tumakuru-specific revenue maps after recovery or through an ordinary portal workflow; current availability and machine-readable geometry are unknown.
